Show the last entries of the finfocus log file

## Synopsis

```text
Print a snapshot of the finfocus log file, oldest entry first, using the same parsing, redaction, filters, and display text as the dashboard Logs view. The file is only read, never modified, and no plugin is started. --grep is a case-insensitive substring match over the message and field values.
```

```text
finfocus logs [flags]
```

## Examples

```bash
  # Last 200 entries of the configured log file
  finfocus logs

  # Everything from one plugin, as JSON
  finfocus logs --tail 0 --source aws-public --output json

  # Warnings and errors that mention a region
  finfocus logs --level warn --grep us-east-1

  # Read another file
  finfocus logs --file ./finfocus.log --output ndjson
```

```text
      --color[=true|false]           Force colored output when stdout is not a terminal
      --file string                  Log file to read (default: the configured logging.file)
      --grep string                  Only entries whose message or field values contain this text (case-insensitive)
  -h, --help[=true|false]            help for logs
      --high-contrast[=true|false]   Use brighter high-contrast colors
      --level string                 Minimum level: trace, debug, info, warn, error, fatal, panic
      --no-color[=true|false]        Disable colored output and interactive TUI
      --output string                Output format (table, json, ndjson) (default "table")
      --plain[=true|false]           Plain text without colors, borders, or an interactive TUI
      --source stringArray           Only entries from this source, such as core or a plugin name (repeatable)
      --tail int                     Number of most recent matching entries to show (0 for all) (default 200)
```
